# Proverbs 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-desire one-separating-himself seeks; against-all sound-wisdom he-breaks-out.

**2** Not does-a-fool delight in-understanding, but-only in-revealing his-heart.

**3** When-comes [the]-wicked, comes also contempt, and-with dishonor, disgrace.

**4** Waters deep [are the]-words-of a-man's mouth; a-brook flowing [is the]-fountain-of wisdom.

**5** To-lift [the]-face-of [the]-wicked [is]-not good, to-turn-aside [the]-righteous in-judgment.

**6** [The]-lips-of a-fool enter into-strife, and-his-mouth calls-for blows.

**7** [The]-mouth-of a-fool [is] his-destruction, and-his-lips [are the]-snare-of his-soul.

**8** [The]-words-of a-whisperer [are]-like-dainty-morsels, and-they go-down into-[the]-chambers-of [the]-belly.

**9** Also one-being-slack in-his-work — a-brother he [is] to-a-master-of destruction.

**10** A-tower-of strength [is the]-name-of YHWH; into-it runs [the]-righteous and-is-set-on-high.

**11** [The]-wealth-of a-rich-man [is] his-strong city, and-like-a-wall high in-his-imagination.

**12** Before destruction [the]-heart-of a-man is-haughty, but-before honor [is] humility.

**13** One-returning a-word before he-hears — folly it [is] to-him and-shame.

**14** [The]-spirit-of a-man sustains his-sickness, but-a-spirit broken — who can-bear-it?

**15** [The]-heart-of [the]-discerning acquires knowledge, and-[the]-ear-of [the]-wise seeks knowledge.

**16** A-man's gift makes-room for-him, and-before great-ones it-leads-him.

**17** [The]-first in-his-case [seems]-righteous, but-comes his-neighbor and-examines-him.

**18** [The]-lot puts-an-end-to contentions, and-between mighty-ones it-decides.

**19** A-brother offended [is harder] than-a-strong city, and-contentions [are]-like-[the]-bar-of a-fortress.

**20** From-[the]-fruit-of a-man's mouth his-belly is-satisfied; [with the]-produce-of his-lips he-is-filled.

**21** Death and-life [are] in-[the]-hand-of [the]-tongue, and-those-loving-it will-eat its-fruit.

**22** One-finding a-wife finds good, and-obtains favor from-YHWH.

**23** Supplications [the]-poor speaks, but-[the]-rich answers harshly.

**24** A-man-of friends [may come] to-ruin, but-there-is a-friend [who]-sticks-closer than-a-brother.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **18:10**: Migdal-oz shem YHWH — 'a tower of strength is the name of YHWH.' The name represents God's accessible presence and character.

- **18:21**: Mavet ve-chayyim be-yad lashon — 'death and life in the hand of the tongue.' One of the most powerful statements on speech in all of Scripture.

- **18:24**: Difficult text. 'A man of friends' (ish re'im) may mean 'a man who has many friends' or 'a man who is friendly.' The contrast with the loyal friend is key.

— EMET
